audience_profile: Senior engineers who use Claude Code or are evaluating it, and want to know which file in a repository does what, and which ones are enforced.
learning_objective: Name each project file and folder Claude Code reads (CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .mcp.json, .claude/settings*.json, rules, skills, commands, agents, hook scripts) and tell guidance from enforced configuration.
creative_concept: A premium multi-scene edit: a different layout and camera move per line inside a generic developer UI, ending on one save-worthy dark diagram.

treatments.name: A. Multi-scene developer UI edit
treatments.shape: terminal, editor, split screen, hub diagram, stacking cards, isometric stack, menu, node graph, lifecycle timeline, full diagram
treatments.engagement: high: a new shot every line
treatments.teaching_fit: strong: each file shown doing its job
treatments.accuracy_risk: low: every UI detail from the docs

treatments.name: B. v1's single building diagram
treatments.verdict: Rejected for v2: one layout for 60 s.

treatments.name: C. Talking-head style captions over b-roll

hook: Frame 0: CLAUDE.md says 'Never delete build/' and the terminal shows rm -rf build/; 'Ignored your rule?'
narrative_structure: A familiar failure; where each file goes; three takeaways; the full diagram to save.
visual_direction: claude-orange-dark: near-black, terracotta and bright orange accents, generic editor windows, warm syntax theme, light rays, the channel's mascot with a cream rim light.
narration_approach: Calm, one line per row; file names spoken as written (Claude dot M D, dot M C P dot jay-son).

scene_breakdown.title: Hook: ignored rule
scene_breakdown.purpose: Frame 0: CLAUDE.md says 'Never delete build/' while the terminal shows rm -rf build/ (illustrative); the rule flashes red; 'Ignored your rule?'; pull back as the explorer expands

scene_breakdown.title: CLAUDE.md
scene_breakdown.purpose: CLAUDE.md types in the editor; on 'loaded every session' it fills the context window

scene_breakdown.title: CLAUDE.local.md
scene_breakdown.purpose: Explorer marks CLAUDE.local.md untracked (U); Add-Content .gitignore; the file dims as ignored

scene_breakdown.title: .mcp.json
scene_breakdown.purpose: Full-screen hub: Claude Code connected to GitHub, Postgres and Jira; 'shared with team'

scene_breakdown.title: settings
scene_breakdown.purpose: IDE: a deny rule; the terminal's rm -rf build/ is denied (illustrative); then the precedence stack

scene_breakdown.title: rules
scene_breakdown.purpose: Full-screen isometric rule cards; a paths glob lights the matching files

scene_breakdown.title: skills and commands
scene_breakdown.purpose: IDE terminal: '/' opens the menu, /review; SKILL.md frontmatter in the editor; commands/ card flips to legacy

scene_breakdown.title: agents
scene_breakdown.purpose: Full-screen node graph: two subagents with their own tools report back

scene_breakdown.title: hooks
scene_breakdown.purpose: IDE: validate-bash.sh, the lifecycle strip, BLOCK on rm -rf (illustrative), npm test allowed

scene_breakdown.title: Takeaway two
scene_breakdown.purpose: Card 2: Must never happen? deny rule or hook (lock); the opening rm -rf build/ is now denied (illustrative)

scene_breakdown.title: Takeaway three
scene_breakdown.purpose: Card 3: Start with CLAUDE.md + settings.json (rocket); wipe into the full diagram; hold 3 s

decisions.choice: tree -a in a terminal morphing into the diagram
decisions.reason: Starts from a command engineers know.
User approved after trimming 145 to 126 words.
User's asset; never covers title, tree rows, card text or arrows.
User's choice; comment colour lightened to #8F877D for 4.5:1.

decisions.choice: match cut, whip pans, zoom-through, push-through, mask reveals, two wipes

dropoff.why: Two files and four terms in one line
dropoff.countermeasure: Wipe into .claude/, mascot taps the row, git badge on the .local file
Camera push into skills/ with the SKILL.md frontmatter, then the legacy tag

experiment: Does a save-worthy final frame lift saves compared with earlier videos?
effects_reason: dev_scene for the per-line scenes; project_tree for the final diagram.
